outcome: mean volume densities of syncytial knots
mean volume densities of syncytial denudations
mean volume densities of foetal capillaries
mean volume densities of intervillous spaces
cohort: Placentae from 34 gestational age-matched women at term, including 20 cases (HIV-infected or HBV-infected) and 14 uninfected controls.
finding: Placental viral infections (HIV and HBV) are associated with significant increases in syncytial knots, foetal capillaries, and syncytial denuded areas, and a significant decrease in intervillous spaces in chorionic villi.
